criteria.requirement: Repair LCSSeq two-input dynamic programming and reconstruction to honor the existing test_func contract, matching the multi-input path. Return matching units from the first input with their original spelling, preserve default == results and stable existing tie behavior, and do not replace arbitrary pairwise predicates with a lowercase/hash-key equivalence assumption. Custom predicates may be nontransitive; errors propagate. No optional backend may bypass the predicate. Deliver a complete repair with public original-failing checks and unchanged upstream tests.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
